challenges.text: Asia Trail: otter splash or red panda climb — which did you get?
Pandas (if on view): chew speed — slow-mo or chomp?
Orangutan O Line: can you spot a cable/tower the apes could use?
Great Cats: lion vs tiger energy today — who owns the yard?
Flamingos: pinkest bird in the flock — point once
Feel the hill: are you walking uphill toward cats or apes right now?
